questions.subject: agriculture
questions.q: With reference to “Over Rs 1,200 Crore Allocated to 10 states under PM-RKVY Agriculture Scheme,‘Khet Bachao Abhiyan’ Launched; Check Beneficiary States”, consider the following statements:
items: The announcements were made during the second day of the National Agriculture Conference–Rabi Campaign 2030.
West Bengal received ₹290 crore, followed by Haryana with ₹198 crore and Andaman and Nicobar Islands with ₹181 crore.
Andhra Pradesh was allocated ₹154 crore, Bihar ₹114 crore and Karnataka ₹104 crore.
questions.ask: How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.why: Statement 1 is incorrect: it is 2026, not 2030. The report says: “The announcements were made during the second day of the National Agriculture Conference–Rabi Campaign 2026.” Statement 2 is incorrect: it is Chhattisgarh, not Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The report says: “West Bengal received ₹290 crore, followed by Haryana with ₹198 crore and Chhattisgarh with ₹181 crore.” Statement 3 is incorrect: it is Arunachal Pradesh, not Andhra Pradesh. The report says: “Arunachal Pradesh was allocated ₹154 crore, Bihar ₹114 crore and Karnataka ₹104 crore.”
